metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:padding_calibration: Eval/no-grad, autocast-disabled measurements on at most 16 nonempty rows from the first two cached training batches. Compare chronological unpadded singleton features with original batches, three extra leading zeros and reversed batch order. Errors cover all valid states, final features and scores for the first at most 100 real item IDs. The elementwise criterion is abs(error)<=1e-5+1.3e-6*abs(reference); normalized violation is error divided by that bound, including explicit-reference and repeated-execution comparisons. Nonfinite features or scores raise an error. The separate absolute-only state criterion remains 1e-5. Explicit-reference error compares singleton features with an eval-mode recurrence using the trained GRU weights, PyTorch gate equations and joint recent-item readout. Repeat error measures identical repeated batch executions. First divergence gives a probe row and zero-based chronological token index. Top10 changes compare ordered candidate lists for original batch versus singleton, with stable candidate-order tie handling. These are fixed training-history candidate probes, not full-catalog rankings or validation HR@10. Precision settings and software versions are recorded. A failed tolerance alone does not establish padding leakage; unresolved errors confound mechanistic context claims. No samples gives null errors and pass flags. No model parameters or scores are averaged.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity of up to 2048 real item embeddings, mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1]. About 0.5 corresponds to zero mean cosine; values approaching 1 indicate directional alignment. This does not measure recommendation diversity or unobserved simulator traits. Null means insufficient pairs.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Contains measured valid-position, low-margin and wrong-rank counts with eps=0.5. Valid positions require nonzero input, positive and negative IDs. Category breakdowns are null because item categories are unavailable. All margin metrics are null when no valid samples exist. These are sampled training margins, not validation HR@10 or a full-catalog ranking measurement.
